description: Front porch, Single and two storey rear extension, External alterations (Demolition of porch canopy, rear conservatory and rear extension)
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
proposed first-floor rear extension, by reason of its flat-roofed design, would
form an incongruous addition that fails to respect the hipped roof form of the
host dwelling and the established character of surrounding properties. The
extension would therefore appear visually obtrusive and out of keeping with the
built form of the locality, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3.D(1), (11) and
(12)&nbsp;of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS1.B of the&nbsp;Harrow Core
Strategy (2012),&nbsp;Policy DM1 A, B (a), (b) and (c) of the Development
Management Policies Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of
the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed single storey rear extension by reason of its excessive projection and siting on the shared boundary with No.120 Headstone Drive, would result in a visually&nbsp;obtrusive and overbearing form of development resulting in an unacceptable sense of enclosure and loss of outlook for the residents of No.120 Headstone Drive, to the detriment of their residential amenities, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D.7) of The London Plan (2021), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
